positions.title: Software & Web Developer (Webmaster)
positions.description:
- Project manager to a team of twelve people in the development of the 2018 redesign of the B-CU website.
- Manage the design, development, and maintenance of the overall architecture of the B-CU website and it's service.
- Develop and manage the B-CU Official APP for B-CU. Programmed in iOS using objective-C and swift. Tasks include performing weekly tests and troubleshoots.
- Provide training, management, and a letter grade to respective faculty members for student intern's web development performance.
- Train faculty, staff, and administration in the startup and management of departmental university websites.
positions.insights: Responsive Web Design, Public Speaking and +25 skills

- Generate graphic images, animations, sounds, text, and video into seamless multimedia using Photoshop and premiere.
- Design diversity, and inclusion training booklets using InDesign.
